issues.explanation: The word «انطباق» here summarises S23728-041's phrase «انطباق با قواعد و مقررات قابل‌اعمال», i.e. regulatory compliance, not conformity to a standard. The terminology rule requires the distinguishing qualifier «(compliance)» or «(conformity)» whenever the two senses of انطباق both appear in the surrounding text — and section 4 itself correctly writes «اثبات انطباق (conformity)» two paragraphs later. Omitting the qualifier on this first occurrence leaves a false-parallel with that later usage.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to «مشاورهٔ حقوقی برای پرسمان‌های انطباق (compliance) با مقررات» (or equivalent wording that makes the regulatory-compliance sense unambiguous).
